verdict.rationale: Maritime has no single built-in in-product copilot. It does let users deploy ready-made template agents in one click with no code and chat with them. These agents run on Maritime's own metered LLM access, so no API key is needed. Users can delegate work to them, such as a self-scheduled digest that the platform turns into wake triggers, acting on a connected Google account, or migrating workloads from another provider. Missing for 10: a native, always-present assistant embedded in the product UI rather than a user-deployed agent, and independent or hands-on corroboration of task delegation.
